subject: Memento kickoff — interference diagnostics for our RL stack
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off Memento. Background: our open-source catastrophic-interference work showed that training a second "Memento" agent from the position where the original agent's checkpoint plateaus reliably pushes past the plateau — evidence the wall is interference, not exploration. Two internal agents teams are hitting suspiciously similar plateaus, and I want this as a standard diagnostic.

Plan for the window (through 06-29):
- 04-17: reproduce the baseline — train the original Rainbow agent (rainbow.gin config) and the Memento agent from its checkpoint on 3 Atari games; confirm the published effect. dqn.gin variant as a stretch.
- 05-22: package the two-stage train_original_agent / train_memento_agent flow as a diagnostic recipe.
- 06-19: run the diagnostic on one internal team's plateaued agent and report.

Alina owns staffing/compute; Carmen is TL. Heads-up that the baseline training is multi-day per game, so compute planning matters here.

Ulla
